purpose: Freeze the pre-refactor state and define the breaking Composer-first rebuild boundary.
principle: Code Composer exists to make music. Contracts preserve and validate the artist's decisions; they do not dictate the composition.

s32_evidence.role: regression evidence; not a migration target

v116_reference.note: Historical reference. Preserve contract rigor, not the authoring surface.

keep: analysis does not silently rewrite music
reject: compatibility debt for unreleased authoring abstractions

boundaries.notes: Preserve validated piano, bowed-string/violin, plucked-bass, percussion, generic engine infrastructure, and DSP unless later evidence requires targeted change.
Preserve mixer, buses, routing, and automation as execution infrastructure.
Preserve validated performance realizers; CR01 may replace how the Composer requests them.
Preserve MIDI and delivery output authority.
Preserve lossless handoff/provenance concepts; schema may follow the new canonical model.
Preserve aggregate validation/render/analyze separation where useful; authoring-specific assumptions may be replaced.
Keep strict canonical validation as a principle; the pre-refactor Music IR shape is not a compatibility requirement.
Remove detailed CompositionBrief as the mandatory composer-facing contract.
No migration adapter. Replace with the new Song/authoring contract.
Replace seed-mutating Brief→Plan compilation with seedless Composer→Song lowering.
Replace the seed_ir + detailed_brief public contract.
Preserve useful algorithms only when they fit the new Song Model. Fixed-role composition authority is not preserved.
Retain strict validation discipline while removing fixed-role and current development-profile assumptions.
Reuse objective measurements where sound; aesthetic thresholds and self-certifying pass/fail semantics must be reviewed.
Historical integrated closure evidence; not a schema compatibility requirement.
Preserve historical evidence; it must not define the new public authoring contract.

explicitly_not_preserved: mandatory seed IR for new composition
role name as a proxy for musical function + instrument + priority + render engine
register_shift semantics that chromatically transpose roles asymmetrically
detailed CompositionBrief as the required first authoring surface
automatic aesthetic closure from QA metrics
legacy authoring compatibility or migration adapters

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: Neutral phrase generation shortened authored rhythm cells by 0.82.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: No hidden note shortening; articulation/gate must be explicit or performance-derived.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: A fresh worker produced broadband TV-static via generic breath+saw+drive/gain.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: Instrument intent must resolve to appropriate engine capabilities; structural noise hazards remain guarded.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: Independent note buffers could terminate non-zero.
Shared harmonic material could become lead +12 / pad +6 / bass 0.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: Register and chromatic transposition are distinct; shared harmonic authority cannot silently diverge.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: sound_palette roles had to pre-exist in seed arrangement.roles.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: New composition is seedless by default and creates its own track/instrument ownership.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: Upper composition model privileged six pop/EDM roles.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: Arbitrary tracks with separated function/instrument/engine semantics.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: Fresh worker declared final despite unmet acceptance and a medium transition issue.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: Hard integrity gates are separate from musical evidence and perceptual closure.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: Fresh-worker package recorded package version but not exact repository source identity.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: Canonical deliverables record exact source/revision provenance.
Portable package manifests use relative paths.

mandatory_regression_evidence.failure: Fresh Windows clone could report roughly the whole repository as modified.
mandatory_regression_evidence.new_boundary_requirement: Repository owns text EOL policy through .gitattributes.

next_slice.name: Minimal Song Model + Contract Foundation
next_slice.entry_condition: CR00 manifest/documentation and cross-platform checkout policy are CI-clean.
